content: {"decision":"Do not mark artifact identity verified or enable production on this evidence alone.","risks":["Catalog labels and echoed IDs are self-reported metadata; they do not prove the serving artifact's identity or revision.","Offline fixtures validate fixture behavior, not the live deployment, routing, or production readiness.","Unobserved model substitutions or revision changes could invalidate prior results."],"required_changes":["Record artifact identity as unverified and separate identity verification from behavioral validation.","Require independently verifiable provenance binding the endpoint to an immutable model revision; if unavailable, retain unverified status and require explicit risk acceptance for any release.","Gate production on live endpoint validation, defined acceptance criteria, monitoring, change detection, and rollback readiness."],"evidence_needed":["Trusted deployment attestation or equivalent provenance linking the endpoint and serving deployment to an immutable model artifact digest or revision.","Live integration, quality, safety, reliability, and load results tied to the evaluated deployment; these establish behavior, not artifact identity.","Evidence of controlled routing and revision changes, operational monitoring, and a tested rollback procedure."]}
